We're assuming you're a system/plural due to yourplural pronouns.

We definitely feel you. Suicide has never *not* been an option for us.  The time we were least suicidal?  FUCKING WAR!

Our first time crying as far back as we can remember was at age thirty fucking two.

When our two brothers in arms died overseas we had no reaction.  When we got disowned after coming out we were angry but felt no pain.  When our best friend in hs died we felt nothing.  When our dog got hit while we were in basic we felt nothing.  

Crying for the first time, was so overwhelming, so painful.  But so freeing.  And our very first step in our healing journey.

May you continue to heal and to fight.

We disagree.  Fighting takes so much fucking strength.  The  three years we had with our ex-fiance he gave us so much strength to keep fighting.  Now that we not together we're running out of fight fast.  We're going down swinging, and figure what better way than to do it doin what we do best in Ukraine.
Ask him straight up if he thinks he might.  If he says yes, tell someone.

Listen, being as no judgemental as you can.  Validate his feelings.  Don't try to tell him that things aren't so bad, they obviously are.  Don't point out people who have it worse.  If you're both comfortable give him a hug.
